idea: Themed weeks, Women day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In 2023-24, 67.6% of women aged 15 and over in Himachal Pradesh were in the labour force: working, seeking work or available for it. India's figure was 41.7%. Among rural women it was 70.2% (India 47.6%); among urban women 45.1% (India 28.0%).

Himachal Pradesh was among the top five states and Union territories in each of the seven yearly rounds from 2017-18, when its figure was 49.6% (India 23.3%). Survey estimates, usual status; small states have small samples. Later reports are by calendar year and are not used here.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (National Statistics Office), Periodic Labour Force Survey, annual reports 2017-18 to 2023-24 (July to June; seven rounds): labour force participation rate, usual status (principal and subsidiary), women aged 15 years and above, rural, urban and together. The labour force is people working, seeking or available for work. Survey estimates; Chandigarh has no rural figure. Later reports are by calendar year (2024, 2025) and are not used here.
